Transparency

Trust grows through transparency.

We want people to understand our work, our plans and the information behind them. This page brings together organisation details and documents approved for public sharing.

01 / Transparency

Organisation details

Organisation name: Siliguri Aashray Welfare Foundation.

Community origin: Bharosa Group during the 2020 COVID-19 lockdown in Siliguri.

Future direction: To become a trusted community organisation across North Bengal over the next three to five years.

Preview: legal entity, registration details and public office information require verified records before publication.

02 / Transparency

Work and program stages

Food and clothing distribution and health-related work have been undertaken. Computer training is upcoming. Women & Livelihood, Environment & Animal Welfare and Human Rights are planned areas of expansion.

03 / Transparency

Governance

Our leadership information will be shared with confirmed names, roles and responsibilities.

04 / Transparency

Registrations and documents

Verified registration information and approved documents will be published here as they are prepared for public access.

05 / Transparency

Reports and activity records

Our public archive will include approved activity information and reports as they become available.

Reports will be added when ready for public sharing.

06 / Transparency

Support and receipts

Support arrangements and contribution records will be explained through the Support Our Work page. Tax benefits or special donation eligibility will be stated only when verified.
